name: Hangzhou Biotest Biotech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Biotest Biotech Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sale, and service of in vitro diagnostic reagents in China and internationally. The company offers point-of-care testing rapid diagnostic reagents for drug abuse, infectious disease, fertility health, tumor market/oncology, cardiology market, veterinary, inflammation, and other testing. It also provides microfluidic immunofluorescence analysis systems; and Diagpal SE and Diagpal lateral flow readers. In addition, the company engages in investing activities.
